message.intelligent_mod.thirsty: You are getting thirsty... find some water!
info.intelligent_mod.title: Intelligent Mod
info.intelligent_mod.heat: • Heat: burning furnaces warm up their chunk
info.intelligent_mod.thirst: • Thirst: water bar, drink with right click on water; empty bar = death
info.intelligent_mod.quicksand: • Quicksand: slows, pulls you in and suffocates (deserts, beaches)
info.intelligent_mod.dry_earth: • Dry Earth: heat dries soil; only water or rain restores it
info.intelligent_mod.water: • Water: evaporates in heat, rain refills lakes, storms cause floods
info.intelligent_mod.fire: • Fire: wooden things near very hot furnaces catch fire
